exclusion_detail: The abstract names no best compound; the follow-up Western blots were run on three compounds (4q, 4i, 4k), so no single compound is determined by the lead rule. Every library member would also need more than 4 reactions (4-step bromoresorcinol 8, two Suzuki couplings with triflation, hydrogenolysis, Mitsunobu, Boc removal, amide coupling).

lead.label: none
lead.why: Abstract states only that the chimeric compounds showed low micromolar antiproliferative activity; Western blot follow-up used 4q, 4i and 4k.

notes: Even the shortest member (4a-x) route is about 10 steps.
